punchline: A janitor who parked where there were no meters left $8 million.
thirty_sec: Brattleboro gas station worker and janitor Ronald Read died in 2014 aged 92. He lived plainly, read the Wall Street Journal daily, invested in stocks and left most of his roughly $8 million estate to a hospital and a library.
question: Which item in your spending gives you the least pleasure?
key_contrast: Small spending and informed investing instead of showy spending.
